buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Payment

PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 5. Past Project Experience Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PAO, BARCF payable at Kalpakkam-603102 . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C PAO, BARCF, Kalpakkam-603102 . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PAO, BARCF, Kalpakkam-603102 A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PAO, BARCF payable at Kalpakkam-603102 . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.

10. Buyer Added Bid Specific SLA Text Clause(s) 1. Total Contract Value = [No of Man-days (Nd) * Charges per man-day(C)] * 1.18 + [( Nd * C) * percentage Service Charges (SC)]. 2. Charges per man-day is inclusive of Wage plus 16.25% of Wages as statutory empl oyer contribution towards ESI-3.25%, EDLI-0.5%, EPF-12% & EPF Admin Charge-0.5%. 3. Estimated Total Contract Value is Inclusive of GST@18%, Percentage Service Charg es @3.85% and other transaction charges. 4. The quoted percentage Service Charges should be Inclusive of GST, and other tran saction charges 5. The percentage Service Charges shall be within 2 (Two) places of decimal. Example : 3.85%, 4.22%, 5.23%, etc., which shall be minimum of 3.85% and maximum of 7.00 % only (incl. GST). If any quote of Service Charges (incl. GST) above or below the rang e of 3.85% to 7% shall be treated as invalid and will be rejected. Also it is mandatory t o fill the column meant for quoting percentage Service Charges, if this column is left b lank the tender become invalid and will be rejected. 6. In the event that more than one bidder emerges as L1, selection shall be made thro ugh the GeM lottery system. 7. The mentioned Charges per man-day(C) is Minimum wages payable to work operati ons. 8. The above Total Contract Value is arrived based on the Department SOR. 9. The tenderer are requested to read and understand “scope of work” and General terms and condition as stipulated in Tender document before quoting the percentage rate in the price bid form. 10. The monthly payment will be on actual execution and shall be made as [Measured No of Man-days x Charges per operation x GST] plus [Measured No of Man-days x Cha rges per operation x quoted percentage Service Charges]. The monthly payment will be inclusive of wages and employer contribution ESI, EDLI, EPF, EPF Admin Charge an d GST (All GST issues as per CGST Act 2017). 11. In each monthly payment bill ESI, EDLI, EPF & EPF Admin Charge of employer’s cont ribution shall be paid to the contractor on production of documentary proof. 12. If the Contractor fail to submit the proof of payment of statutory employer contribut ion, the bill amount equivalent to16.25% of Total Man-days charge will be withheld an d will be released in subsequent/next monthly payment bill on submission of proof of payment. 13. Definition of 1No of Operation = Carried out operation/maintenance work for 8 hrs b y one qualified person with necessary tools and Skill. 14. The bidder must have successfully executed/completed similar services over the las t three years as per Sl. No 6. Past Experience of Similar Services of bid document. Simi lar services means “Providing Technical Assistance/Manpower Outsourcing Services to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU / private firms (for Private firms “Form 26A S” Need to submit)". 15. The bidder should have successfully completed at least one work of any value, invol ving Providing Technical Assistance /Technical Supervisor /Inspection Services or Proje ct Management Services for Construction/ Projects/ Fabrication/Plant operation having Mechanical or Chemical or Electrical or Instrumentation operations in any Government /Public Sector or Private Organization (for Private firms orders “Form 26AS” Need to su

bmit)". 16. Proof of Geographical presence: Tamil Nadu Address in 1) Udyam Registration Certif icate (for services) or 2) GST Registration Certificate or 3) Valid Rental Agreement or 4 ) latest (within the last 3 months) EB/Telephone Bill. 17. The bidder shall submit a Work Completion Certificate issued by the Buyer/User De partment (along with the corresponding Work Order) in support of the claimed experie nce in similar works. Work Orders alone and/or ongoing works shall not be considered for establishing the required work experience. In the absence of requisite Work Compl etion Certificate, the offer shall be considered as incomplete. 18. Bidder has to submit Undertaking for Minimum Wages, Undertaking for Financial & Legal Status and other documents as per the Documents format & Checklist enclosed. 19. The manpower provided by the service provider/contractor shall not be deemed em ployees of the buyer department, hence the compliance of the applicable acts/laws wil l be the sole responsibility of the service provider/contractor. 20. The service provider/contractor shall be the “Employer” within the meaning of differ ent Rules & Acts in respect of manpower so deployed. The persons deployed the servi ce provider/contractor shall not have claim whatsoever like employer and employee r elationship against the Buyer. 21. Successful bidder should deposit an amount equal to 3% value of the contract as Ac count Payee Demand Draft, Fixed Deposit Receipt from a schedule bank or irrevocable performance guarantee from a schedule bank drawn in favour of Pay & Accounts Offic er, BARC Facilities, Kalpakkam and payable at Kalpakkam. 22. Resources/manpower deployed shall undergo mandatory safety induction training a t site. The successful bidder/Contractor should arrange necessary PPE like safety shoe s, safety Helmet, safety goggles mask etc. as applicable at site. Police verification cert ificate (PVC) mandatory for all the Resources/manpower as site. The successful bidd er should deploy one site supervisor for liaison with department and to manage day to day activities at site. The successful bidder is fully responsible the persons deployed t owards compliance for the safety precaution, security instruction and professional con duct at site.
